tagline: A Charming Bayside Home in the heart of Dennis
welcomeMessage: Welcome to our relaxing home, tucked away on a quiet street just minutes from the beach and everything Dennis and Cape Cod have to offer. We're so glad you're here, and we hope you leave feeling like you got a real taste of the Cape. If there's ever anything we can do to improve your stay, please don't hesitate to reach out.

checkIn.arrivalMessage: We'll send you detailed check-in instructions by message a day or two before your arrival.
checkIn.parkingNote: There's parking in the driveway for at least 3 cars. If you see our Jeep parked there during the summer months, please just work around it — and we kindly ask that you avoid parking on the grass.
checkIn.doorLockNote: You'll receive the door code in advance of your check-in date. The same code works for both the front and back doors. Please remember to lock up whenever you're off the property.
checkIn.linensNote: All linens and towels are freshly cleaned and set out ahead of your check-in.

checkOut.notice: You'll receive an email with detailed check-out instructions 18 hours before your check-out time.
checkOut.trash: Please take out all trash and recycling and place it in the closed bins by the shed. A valet service empties and replaces the bins, so there's no need to move them anywhere else.
checkOut.sheetsTowels: Please place any used sheets and towels on the floor of the bedroom they were used in, so the cleaning team knows what to wash and replace.
checkOut.windows: Please close and lock any doors or windows before you go.
checkOut.thermostat: Please set the thermostat to COOL 72° in the summer and HEAT 65° in the winter.
checkOut.shedYard: The shed is stocked with beach chairs, lawn games, toys, and more for you to use. If you used anything, please repack it and return it to the shed.
checkOut.accidents: Accidents happen — no biggie! Please just let us know about any damage, stains, or broken items during your stay so our team can take care of it before the next guest arrives.

houseRules: Renters must be 25 years of age or older
We live in a quiet neighborhood — please be respectful of our neighbors and quiet hours

itemsAvailable.label: Beach chairs
itemsAvailable.detail: You're welcome to use ours, but we'd recommend bringing your own.

faq.question: How do the outdoor lights work?
faq.answer: Plug in the cord hanging off the shed to turn the outdoor lights on. Please turn them off when you're not using them and before heading to bed.

faq.question: Can we use the fire pit?
faq.answer: Yes! Please use extreme caution, and never leave the fire going without the lid on the fire pit. Make sure the fire is fully out before you turn in for the night.

faq.question: Where's the laundry?
faq.answer: In the basement. You're welcome to use it, and detergent is included — just use a reasonable amount so there's plenty left for the next guest.

localRecommendations.name: Bayview Beach
localRecommendations.note: Calm bay water, a favorite sunset spot, and a short drive from the house.

localRecommendations.name: Mayflower Beach
localRecommendations.note: Wide tidal flats, warm shallow water, and a snack bar — a Cape Cod classic.

localRecommendations.name: Chapin Memorial Beach
localRecommendations.note: Quiet and less crowded than its neighbors, with great tide pools at low tide.

localRecommendations.name: Corporation Beach
localRecommendations.note: Family-friendly bay beach with a snack shack, restrooms, and good shell hunting.

localRecommendations.name: Cold Storage Beach
localRecommendations.note: A smaller, less crowded bay beach that locals love for evening sunsets.

localRecommendations.name: Village Coffee Shop
localRecommendations.note: A tiny, old-school Cape donut shop — go for the apple fritters and classic drip coffee.

localRecommendations.name: The Mercantile
localRecommendations.note: Bright, kid-friendly cafe with excellent coffee and fresh-baked sandwiches.

localRecommendations.name: Underground Bakery
localRecommendations.note: A cozy hideaway bakery in Dennis Village known for donuts and scones.

localRecommendations.name: Seven Days Restaurant
localRecommendations.note: A cozy, family-run breakfast and brunch spot with a warm, welcoming feel.

localRecommendations.name: The Mercantile
localRecommendations.note: Bright, kid-friendly cafe for breakfast and coffee — they also make great sandwiches if you're back for lunch.

localRecommendations.name: Grumpy's
localRecommendations.note: Lively, no-frills breakfast diner right on 6A — hearty portions and fast service.

localRecommendations.name: Red Cottage Restaurant
localRecommendations.note: A beloved local institution for breakfast, famous for its popovers and lobster eggs Benedict.

localRecommendations.name: Scargo
localRecommendations.note: An upscale but relaxed American bistro with a strong bar program and seafood-forward menu.

localRecommendations.name: The Marshside
localRecommendations.note: Gorgeous marsh views and a menu of elevated seafood and comfort classics.

localRecommendations.name: Sesuit Harbor Cafe
localRecommendations.note: Waterfront picnic-table seafood shack with some of the best sunsets around — cash only.

localRecommendations.name: Leonessa
localRecommendations.note: Refined Italian dining on Route 6A, great for a special night out.

localRecommendations.name: Cape Cod Creamery
localRecommendations.note: Rich, homemade small-batch ice cream with creative flavors and a friendly patio.

localRecommendations.name: Captain Frosty's
localRecommendations.note: Cape Cod seafood shack with a soft-serve and ice cream counter loved for three decades.

localRecommendations.name: Smuggler's
localRecommendations.note: A Cape Cod tradition since forever — homemade ice cream, cash only, worth the wait.

localRecommendations.name: Scargo Tower
localRecommendations.note: Climb the spiral stone tower for one of the best panoramic views on the Cape.

localRecommendations.name: The Cape Playhouse
localRecommendations.note: America's oldest continuously operating professional summer theater, right in Dennis Village.

localRecommendations.name: Cape Cod Museum of Art
localRecommendations.note: A small, well-curated museum showcasing Cape-connected artists.

localRecommendations.name: Cape Cod Rail Trail
localRecommendations.note: Rent bikes and ride the Cape's beautiful, mostly-shaded 22-mile paved trail.

localRecommendations.name: Bass River Kayaks and Paddle Boards
localRecommendations.note: Paddle the calm, scenic Bass River — kayaks and paddleboards available to rent.

localRecommendations.name: Dennis Public Market
localRecommendations.note: The closest grocery store to the house — a great little local market with a butcher counter and prepared foods.

localRecommendations.name: Peterson's Market
localRecommendations.note: Well-stocked market with a strong prepared-foods and deli selection.
